articles.title: HazeSpikeMamba: Coupling Spiking-Inspired and State-Space Features for Self-Supervised Real-World Dehazing
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2608.06886v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dehazing networks are commonly trained on synthetic hazy-clear pairs, but their performance often drops on real photographs. Synthetic haze generated using the atmospheric scattering model does not fully capture the variability of real haze, and paired real hazy-clear images are scarce. In this work, we propose HazeSpikeMamba, a compact dehazing framework that combines a spiking-inspired local path and an attentive state-space global path in a multi-scale U-Net. The local path uses TPCNNSpike, a new spike-emission scheme inspired by the neighborhood coupling of Pulse-Coupled Neural Network (PCNN). Unlike grouped directional scanning, TPCNNSpike updates all neurons in parallel using the previous firing states of their Gaussian-weighted neighborhoods. The global path adapts the Attentive State-Space Module of MambaIRv2, retaining semantic prompting and sequence reordering while removing the window self-attention branch. Its state-space processing models long-range dependencies with complexity linear in sequence length. For target-domain adaptation, a frozen degradation network, pretrained on paired NH-HAZE data, re-synthesizes haze from the dehazed prediction. The reconstruction error updates only the final restoration layers of HazeSpikeMamba without haze-free labels during adaptation. A shared checkpoint is adapted once on each complete unlabeled target set, making the evaluation dataset-level and transductive rather than zero-shot or per-image optimization. The forward network contains 2.02M active parameters and requires 13.27G nominal MACs (measured with thop at 256x256 input). articles.title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling across Scene Geometries
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2608.08600v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not assume a predefined number of agents, while agent-specific observations should be generated by querying this state through a unified rendering interface. Based on this insight, we propose Khora, a scalable multi-agent world model that supports inference-time expansion to arbitrary numbers of agents without retraining. Our framework decouples world-state evolution from visual rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering mechanism for incorporating other agent information. This design maintains cross-view consistency through the shared world state rather than through dense interactions among observation streams inside the expensive video generator, enabling approximately linear practical scaling with the number of queried views. Qualitative experiments demonstrate that our approach generalizes to unseen numbers of agents while maintaining visual quality and multi-agent consistency. We further implement a real-time interactive system to demonstrate scalable open-world simulation.

articles.title: NeoWorld-Pro: Programming Interactive Scenes from Monocular Images for Embodied Simulation
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2608.24212v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The advancement of Embodied AI necessitates high-quality simulation assets that faithfully mirror the real world. However, transforming raw visual observations into simulation-ready scenes remains challenging due to the lack of physical grounding and scene-level interactivity in current image-to-URDF methods. We propose NeoWorld-Pro, a framework that reformulates monocular scene reconstruction as procedural programming for interactive 3D environments. Leveraging the zero-shot reasoning and code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs, NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into executable programs specifying object geometry, articulation, and physical properties. A physics-in-the-loop mechanism then iteratively refines the generated programs by validating their execution in a physics engine, enforcing physically plausible articulations, valid object compositions and interactions, and accurate spatial relationships. Experiments show that NeoWorld-Pro outperforms open-loop and prior monocular reconstruction methods, while enabling complex downstream tasks such as stable stacking and fine-grained manipulation.

articles.title: Beyond Visual Boundaries: Rethinking Scene Segmentation for Movie RAG
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2608.28699v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding long-form video remains a fundamental challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Sparse frame sampling fails to capture fine-grained visual details, while dense sampling quickly exceeds context length limits. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offers a promising middle ground by selectively retrieving relevant video segments for grounded generation, yet its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the video segments used as retrieval units. In this paper, we investigate RAG for movie understanding, which demands story-level reasoning over characters, events, and narrative arcs spanning hours of content. Scene segmentation, a long-studied problem that partitions movies into semantically coherent units, is a natural candidate for defining such retrieval units. We reexamine whether existing methods actually serve this role through comprehensive evaluation on downstream movie understanding tasks, and find that they do not provide a consistent or dominant advantage over naive uniform temporal chunking. Our audit of the most standard scene segmentation benchmarks reveals why: current annotations prioritize visually salient transitions over narrative event structure. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce NarraScene, a narrative-centric scene segmentation dataset annotated with a three-level cognitive taxonomy spanning physical, character, and narrative change, where every valid boundary requires a narrative-level shift. articles.title: ReFlowSET: Representation-Aligned Latent Flow Matching for SAR-to-EO Image Translation
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2609.00968v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: SAR-to-EO image translation aims to generate electro-optical (EO) imagery from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations. Existing latent diffusion approaches typically inherit a predetermined autoencoder, although reconstruction fidelity can vary substantially across codecs and modalities. Because the latent codec affects the round-trip preservation of both SAR conditions and EO targets, codec selection constitutes a fundamental design choice; nevertheless, existing methods largely rely on codecs pretrained on natural images. To remedy this, we introduce ReFlowSET, a conditional latent flow-matching framework that selects its codec through a joint SAR--EO reconstruction audit. Rather than inheriting a heavyweight pretrained generator, ReFlowSET trains a substantially smaller conditional DiT from scratch in the selected latent space, using dual-stream SAR conditioning followed by joint feature refinement. To provide semantic guidance for this from-scratch training, intermediate noisy-EO features are aligned with clean target-EO representations extracted by a frozen vision foundation model. This alignment is used only during training and introduces no additional inference cost. Experiments on QXS-SAROPT and SAR2Opt demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across diverse perceptual fidelity and distributional metrics. Code and pretrained weights are publicly available at https://github.com/KAIST-VICLab/ReFlowSET.

articles.title: Beyond Gait: Person Identification from Millimeter-Wave Point Clouds Across Activities of Daily Living
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2609.08818v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Person identification from millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar point clouds has primarily focused on gait. However, since indoor walking is typically brief and fragmented, gait-based identification is largely constrained to designated passages that support continuous walking. Meanwhile, non-gait activities of daily living (ADLs) are pervasive and also encode discriminative personal signatures. In this study, we evaluate the feasibility of ADL-based identification from sparse mmWave point clouds using mm-ADL, a dataset comprising seven core ADLs collected from 11 subjects under controlled protocols. Moving beyond uniform gait introduces significant activity-dependent variations that confound identity representations. To address this challenge, we systematically benchmark three activity-identity learning paradigms: monolithic learning, joint multi-task learning, and two-stage activity-conditioned routing, under both closed-set identification (ID) and subject-disjoint re-identification (ReID) biometric settings. In parallel, we propose Dual-Stream Static-Dynamic PointNet (DS-SDPNet), an architecture tailored to radar point clouds that captures complementary spatial morphology and motion dynamics. Across seven ADLs, DS-SDPNet achieves 70.2% mean closed-set identification accuracy and outperforms existing baselines on both mm-ADL and mmGait. Moreover, benchmarking the three paradigms without ground-truth activity labels during inference yields up to 68.0% closed-set accuracy and 75.4% ReID mAP, providing a systematic baseline and confirming the feasibility of point-cloud-based biometric identification across diverse daily activities.

articles.title: Decoder-Agnostic Token Merging for Vision Transformers: A Systematic Study of G2TM
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2609.18279v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance across a range of computer vision tasks, mainly thanks to the self-attention mechanism. However, its complexity, increasing quadratically with the number of tokens, remains the major obstacle to ViT efficiency and deployment at scale. Token merging reduces this cost by aggregating redundant tokens. Yet existing methods are typically evaluated within a single architecture, leaving open whether their effectiveness stems from the merging mechanism itself or from the specific decoder they are paired with. We extend Graph-Guided Token Merging (G2TM), a single module inserted early in a ViT-based network, beyond its original Segmenter setting. We evaluate G2TM across three semantic segmentation frameworks (Segmenter, SETR, EoMT) and three decoder families (Linear, Transformer-, convolution-based), as well as standard ViT image classification. Our results show that G2TM's behavior and accuracy-efficiency trade-off are consistent across every tested architecture for a given backbone size, indicating that its effectiveness is a property of the encoder rather than the decoder. G2TM also generalizes well to image classification, achieving an even smaller degradation in accuracy compared to semantic segmentation. We further find that G2TM's optimal hyperparameters, resulting in a consistent drop in GFLOPs of 22-47% and an increase in throughput by up to 74% for segmentation models on ADE20K dataset, depend primarily on the backbone's pre-training recipe and on the target dataset, rather than on the decoder choice.

articles.title: Undertone: Personalizing Frozen VLM Aesthetic Judges from Few Ratings
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2609.27110v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Image quality assessment predicts a mean opinion score (MOS), but for image aesthetics the mean hides the individual, so personalized assessment must start from the few images a new user rates. Fitting each person from scratch fails with ten ratings; networks fine-tuned per person carry over poorly to new kinds of images. We present Undertone-P, which learns from other raters a Gaussian prior over per-person regression weights on read-outs of frozen vision-language model (VLM) judges: the probability-weighted rating and the hidden state at the score token. Since people differ from the crowd in ways other raters reveal, a few ratings need only choose among those ways: a new user costs one closed-form solve, and no network is trained. On Ryu and Yanaka's PARA benchmark, the prior alone reaches a Spearman correlation of .640, above the best published 10- and 100-rating results (.581 and .620); 10 and 100 of a person's ratings raise it to .648 and .676. These ratings add most where tastes depart from the crowd: with 100 ratings, +.067 for the raters who agree least with it and +.206 on LAPIS artworks, against +.037 overall. Without labels, the judges' expected scores predict PARA's MOS at .835 (best published model we ran: .694). PARA-trained networks still lead under PARA's original protocol, likely through a stronger end-to-end MOS model.

articles.title: Preserving DEG Rankings for Gene Discovery in Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2609.33928v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Predicting spatial gene expression from histology images could scale spatial transcriptomics (ST) to image-only cohorts, but conventional histology-based ST prediction is trained and evaluated mainly by per-gene spatial-profile reconstruction. This objective is misaligned with a key downstream use of ST: differentially expressed gene (DEG) discovery, where genes are ranked for a biological or morphology-defined contrast by evidence of between-group expression differences. We formulate image-based differential expression ranking (IDER), which asks whether predicted expression profiles preserve the contrast-specific ranked gene list obtained from measured profiles. IDER compares gene rankings induced by differential-expression statistics, rather than raw expression magnitudes or per-gene spatial correlations. We further introduce a differentiable IDER objective that aligns these statistics across genes and can be trained with morphology-derived proxy contrasts without predefined biological group labels. Experiments on public ST datasets show improved DEG-ranking agreement and pathway-enrichment overlap over conventional reconstruction objectives, including morphology-derived and pathologist-annotated tissue-region evaluations.

articles.title: FLASH: A "Generate Once, Synthesize Many" Framework for Synthetic Anomaly Generation in Industrial Anomaly Detection
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2609.37314v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Synthetic anomaly generation helps expand industrial anomaly datasets when real defects are scarce or unavailable. Existing approaches lie at two extremes: procedural approaches are fast but struggle to represent complex anomalies, while generative approaches produce diverse defects but require costly per-sample generation. We present FLASH, a framework that decouples defect generation from anomaly synthesis under a ``generate once, synthesize many'' paradigm. Given only normal images, FLASH uses Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance and an image-generation model to produce a small set of defect images, from which it extracts, validates, and banks reusable defect patches. For synthesis of anomalous images, Object Boundary Suppression (OBS) first identifies the probable foreground object-aware region of the host image, while Multi-Resolution Spectral Pyramid (MRSP) noise generates diverse, size-controllable masks that determine the defect location and spatial extent. It then composes a large and diverse synthetic anomalous image set by localizing the defect region, sampling size-controllable placement masks and seamlessly blending retrieved defects onto new defect-free images without further need for image generation. Experiments on the MVTec AD 2 dataset show that FLASH-generated anomalies nearly close the calibration gap on real defects, reaching 78.1% image-level F1 against an 83.6% real-anomaly upper bound and providing the most consistent calibration transfer across detectors among procedural and generative alternatives. Moreover, FLASH synthesizes anomalies more than 11.95x faster than per-sample generative approaches.

articles.title: PickMoment: Continuous-Time Single-Image-to-Video via Learning Deblurring and Blur-to-Video
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2610.01279v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motion blur arises from the temporal integration of a continuous sharp signal over a finite exposure window, yet existing learning-based methods sidestep this physical model and predict only the sharp signal itself: most single-image deblurring methods recover a single frame at the exposure center, while blur-to-video methods predict a fixed set of frames. We introduce PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation that directly learns the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure with a single deterministic model. Drawing an analogy to MeanFlow's average-velocity formulation, we train the model with three supervisions derived from the blur integral: an empirical reconstruction loss from available subframes, an additivity loss that enforces self-consistency across overlapping sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss anchored at the zero-interval limit. A single trained model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time pick-a-moment recovery as different queries to the same network, with no separate training for each task. Our PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while competitive against restoration-based methods on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass without iterative sampling.

articles.title: 澳門首宗國安案 被告區錦新判囚12年6個月
articles.feed_excerpt: 澳門首宗國安案，被告區錦新判監12年6個月。 根據法院判詞，被告區錦新裁定一項顛覆國家政權罪，兩項「與澳門特別行政區以外的組織、團體或個人建立聯繫作出危害國家安全的行為罪」；一項「違反保密罪」罪成，數罪並罰，法庭最終判區錦新入獄12年6個月。 至於另外兩項「顛覆國家政權罪」不成立，一項「與澳門特別行政區以外的組織、團體或個人建立聯繫作出危害國家安全的行為罪」則不獨立處罰。 判詞指出，合議庭庭審過程，已審慎全面客觀分析所有證據的基礎，認定起訴書內絕大部分事實。被告對大部分基礎事實並無異議，亦承認勾結和串通多個境外組織的事實行為，構成犯罪。區錦新長期親身協助和配合境外敵對組織收集、預備及公然散布明顯充斥屬於顛覆國家政權的政治主張，以及屬於虛假且明顯有所歪曲的圖片及資訊，藉此勾連境外敵對組織的非法手段共謀煽動澳門居民對中央人民政府的仇恨，以圖推翻、破壞《中華人民共和國憲法》所確立的國家根本制度。 至於違反保密罪，區錦新在2021年時任立法會議員，將參與立法會一個委員會閉門會議而得悉的秘密內容，向境外組織洩漏，可能造成十分嚴重的後果。 編輯：譚佩貞

articles.title: 港商及理大參展進博會推廣產品與科研成果 會計師行助內企出海
articles.feed_excerpt: 今屆進博會有超過400間香港企業參展，數目和規模創歷來新高。有參展港商期望透過進博會，打入內地市場。 有本港手工啤酒品牌首次參展進博會，帶來公司在港生產、於國際啤酒比賽獲獎的產品。公司市場總監蘇文潔說，香港市場相對細小，期望放眼內地的市場，而內地消費者鍾情香港製造產品，相信產品在內地具競爭力。 香港理工大學今屆繼續參展，展示食品科技和機械人等項目。理大副校長鄭子劍表示，以往參展獲得不錯反應，他形容本港是超級中轉站，扮演獨特角色，理大在本港高等院校中定位清晰，與內地合作建立多個技術創新研究院，從中可應用內地完整產業鏈。 特區政府支持內地企業經香港「走出去」，有參展的香港會計師行說，過去一年內地客戶有意出海數量按年增加3成。該行大中華區行政總裁羅漢文形容，內地企業出海意願強烈。香港了解海外投資環境和稅制，在內地企業出海過程中可提供協助。 編輯：黃佩珊

articles.summary_zh: 今屆進博會有超過400間香港企業參展，數目和規模創歷來新高。有參展港商期望透過進博會，打入內地市場。 有本港手工啤酒品牌首次參展進博會，帶來公司在港生產、於國際啤酒比賽獲獎的產品。公司市場總監蘇文潔說，香港市場相對細小，期望放眼內地的市場，而內地消費者鍾情香港製造產品，相信產品在內地具競爭力。 香港理工大學今屆繼續參展，展示食品科技和機械人等項目。理大副校長鄭子劍表示，以往參展獲得不錯反應，他形容本港是超級中轉站，扮演獨特角色，理大在本港高等院校中定位清晰，與內地合作建立多個技術創新研究院，從中可應用內地完整產業鏈。 特區政府支持內地企業經香港「走出去」，有參展的香港會計師行說，過去一年內地客戶有意出海數量按年增加3成。該行大中華區行政總裁羅漢文形容，內地企業出海意願強烈。香港了解海外投資環境和稅制，在內地企業出海過程中可提供協助。 編輯：黃佩珊

articles.title: Look Before You Launch: Learned Throughput Prediction for Hardware Selection in a Production Training Fleet
articles.feed_excerpt: arXiv:2611.04057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In mixed-vendor accelerator fleets, many training jobs can run on several hardware types, and the best choice depends on each job's throughput on each type. Routing a job needs a throughput estimate for every candidate type before the job runs. We present LEAP, a machine learning performance prediction service that predicts each training job's throughput on every candidate hardware type at submission time and ranks the candidates by predicted throughput per unit cost. It routes tens of thousands of training job attempts a day across hundreds of different model types and more than 20 hardware types in a production fleet. LEAP predicts throughput from submission-time training configuration, including each job's prior throughput. LEAP reaches an accuracy of 77% over 30 nightly retrains, higher than the lookup table it replaced and at least as high as every alternative model we tested, including fine-tuned language models. Over six months, the share of eligible training GPU-hours that received a ranking by LEAP grew from 58% to 95%, and we estimate that it saves about 3% of training computational cost. In this paper, we identify the drivers that actually move accuracy and those that do not. We offer these as lessons for teams building performance predictors at fleet scale.

articles.feed_excerpt: 人民銀行公布，明日開展證券、基金、保險公司互換便利（SFISF）操作，以支持資本市場健康穩定發展。互換期限1年，可視情況展期，目前有31家證券、基金公司申報需求，申請額度超過1000億元人民幣。另外，股票回購增持再貸款政策，由階段性安排轉為長期制度性安排，再貸款利率由1.25厘降至1厘。 人行會同金融監管總局、中國證監會等部門先後召開證券、基金、保險公司互換便利座談會和股票回購增持再貸款座談會，聽取金融機構業務進展及意見建議。會議提出，為維護資本市場穩定，提升市場韌性和信心，適時開展證券、基金、保險公司互換便利操作，進一步增加參與機構數量，適當降低互換費率，優化質押和操作模式。金融機構堅持市場化定價原則，在再貸款利率基礎上合理加點並增加貸款投放。 會議指，將繼續加強政策支持，進一步優化政策要素和實施細則，激勵金融機構用好用足政策工具，支持資本市場健康穩定發展。 人行新聞稿提到，支持資本市場兩項工具自2024年10月推出以來，證券、基金、保險公司互換便利已多次展期，目前餘額1050億元；政策支持下，股票回購增持貸款簽約金額約4400億元，累計發放量逾2800億元。 編輯：張詩民

briefing.title: 美国中期选举后AI忧虑重挫日韩股市
briefing.summary: 因担忧中期选举结果或拖慢AI数据中心投资热潮，美股隔夜大跌后，日经225早盘跌5.1%至56930点，韩国Kospi跌8.5%至4923点并触发熔断。

selection.impact: 日韩股市暴跌并触发熔断，AI投资担忧引发跨市场系统性震荡。

briefing.title: 尼日利亚法院禁止反对党领袖参选，选举前景存疑
briefing.summary: 尼日利亚法院取消阿提库·阿布巴卡尔作为反对党ADC总统候选人的资格，距大选仅两个月。

selection.impact: 距大选两月法院取消反对党候选人资格，直接动摇尼日利亚选举公正性。

briefing.title: 索马里最高法院驳回总统任期延长，政治危机加剧
briefing.summary: 该国自1969年以来首次全国选举原定明年举行，这一时间表现在存疑。

selection.impact: 最高法院驳回总统任期延长，索马里首次全国选举时间表面临存疑。

briefing.title: 南非非国大遭遇最严重选举倒退
briefing.summary: 曼德拉所属政党预计以31.7%得票率仍居首，主要对手民主联盟为25.8%；该党曾长期获超60%选票，此次为历史最低。

selection.impact: 非国大得票创历史最低，南非执政格局与联盟政治面临重大变化。

briefing.title: 援助团队称苏丹苦难有目共睹，残酷战争仍在持续
briefing.summary: 援助团队周五呼吁增加国际援助，称资金严重短缺、仓库空置且需求巨大，数百万人流离失所。

selection.impact: 苏丹战事持续，援助资金严重短缺、数百万人流离失所，人道危机紧迫。

briefing.title: 區錦新案 澳門特區政府：尊重並支持法院依法宣判
briefing.summary: 澳門首宗國安法案件宣判，被告區錦新一項「顛覆國家政權罪」、兩項「與澳門特別行政區以外的組織、團體或個人建立聯繫作出危害國家安全的行為罪」，以及一項「違反保密罪」罪成，判入獄12年6個月。 澳門特區政府表示，尊重並支持法院依法宣判首宗違反《維護國家安全法》案件，又呼籲社會各界尊重法院裁決，支持司法機關依法行使審判權和維護司法公正與法治傳統。 新聞稿表示，初級法院刑事法庭是依法獨立審理首宗國安案和判決，充分保障了被告等訴訟參與人的合法權益。強調維護國家安全是澳門特區的憲制責任，特區政府的立場是堅定不移地維護國家安全、尊重司法獨立和捍衛法治，決不動搖。未來將繼續嚴格執行澳門《維護國家安全法》，依法防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全的行為，並持續深化國家安全與法治教育，進一步築牢特區維護國家安全的防線，保障澳門長期繁榮穩定及市民根本利益，確保澳門特色的「一國兩制」實踐行穩致遠。 編輯：譚佩貞

selection.impact: 澳门首宗国安法案件宣判，涉及国家安全司法适用的标志性判例。
